description: Inspect projects: list directories and read README files, source code and documentation on Pilon's devices using SSH. Also resolve saved locations, run Linux commands and transfer files.

function.name: list_locations
function.description: List saved bookmarks and user-named network locations with paths, device names, and usernames. Use this to resolve a location referred to by name.

function.name: list_devices
function.description: List known Tailscale devices and saved SSH destinations with usernames and availability.

function.name: ssh_exec
function.description: Inspect files or run Linux shell commands on a remote host. Use ls or find to list projects, and cat or sed to read README files and source. YOLO runs commands automatically; Approve asks the user first. Passwords are handled outside chat.

target.description: Device name/target from get_app_context.devices. Also accepts a hostname, IP or username@host. Use target alone for a discovered device. If both are omitted, uses the selected remote Files device.

working_directory.description: Absolute directory. Defaults to the current Files folder when target and account match; otherwise the remote home directory. An empty string explicitly selects home. Each call starts fresh.

host.description: Explicit SSH hostname or IP when not using a known device target. Omit when target is supplied.

username.description: SSH account; defaults to known target account or current local user.

function.name: list_attachments
function.description: List files the user attached, with opaque IDs usable for SCP upload.

function.name: scp_transfer
function.description: Upload a local file or download a remote file into the agent workspace or an explicit path. YOLO runs transfers automatically; Approve asks the user first.

target.description: Known device name, hostname, IP address, or username@host.

attachment_id.description: Alternative to local_path for uploading a chat attachment.

filename.description: Optional downloaded filename, default remote filename, in the workspace downloads folder.

host.description: Explicit SSH host; can be used instead of target.

username.description: SSH account; defaults to known target account or current local user.

local_path.description: Local upload source or download destination. Relative to the agent workspace. Downloads replace this path atomically after success.
